last_edition.label: 15th annual (2026), 'High Octane', Jogja Expo Center indoor and outdoor

attendance.note: 26,787 visitors over two days (10 to 11 Oct 2026), reported by Impessa and Mata Maluku and an Instagram post headline (Google snippets); likely organiser-reported. 2024: 25,647.

ticket_price.note: Artatix lists tickets 'from Rp70,000'; under-5s (110 cm or shorter) free; on-the-spot sales also offered. Overland ride package IDR 500,000 incl. 2-day pass. Replaces the aggregator's free-entry listing.

add_sources.note: Google snippet (10 Oct 2026): opening of KUSTOMFEST 2026 attended by the Mayor of Yogyakarta; 200+ curated vehicles at JEC (Financial News).
@kustomfest (11 Oct 2026): day one done, day two under way; 'KUSTOMFEST 2026 High Octane, 10-11 October 2026, Jogja Expo Center (Indoor + Outdoor)'.
Google snippet: Kustomfest 2026 drew 26,787 visitors over two days, 10 to 11 Oct 2026.
Google snippet: 2024 edition drew 25,647 visitors over two days.
Artatix ticket page: 'Harga mulai dari Rp70.000'; children under 5 and 110 cm or shorter free; child tickets (5 to 10) bought with an adult.
@kustomfest (10 Oct 2026): tickets can be bought on the spot or online via Artatix.
Crawled site (copyright 2026 Kustomfest) carries the same WhatsApp hotline as the @kustomfest 2026 posts, so kustomfest.com is the official site.
@repsol.lubricants.id (13 Oct 2026): Flat Track at KUSTOMFEST 2026, thanking @kustomfest; follow-up post https://www.instagram.com/p/DeoldeYJXF-/.

Post co-authored by @hondamodifikasi and @kustomfest (15 Oct 2026): Honda booth, live pinstriping 'Stylo x Kustomfest' with @freeflow.66, talkshow with @ultimate_custom; separate giveaway of a Honda Stylo (pack context 13 Oct 2026).
@kustomfest (9 Oct 2026): 'High-Octane Wonderful Indonesia Overland Ride' on Merapi slopes; riders wear vintage outfits by @unionwell; IDR 500K package incl. 2-day pass; tagged #RepsolLubricants.
Honda live pinstriping station (customisation-station) and booth; Repsol flat track competition.

notes: 2026 (15th) edition held 10 to 11 Oct with 26,787 visitors; ticketed from IDR 70,000 via Artatix (the earlier free-entry listing was wrong). New 2026 partners: Repsol Lubricants (flat track), Honda (booth, pinstriping, giveaway), Wonderful Indonesia (overland ride). Retro Classic Cycles is Lulut Wahyudi's workshop (Pandangan Jogja) and @lulut_retro is heavily tagged by @kustomfest, so its 'presented by' credit may be organiser-linked: not added; please check.
